verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is documented as a server connecting publishers to subscribers, with fan-out and send-only-when-watched behavior. A production report confirms one relay fanning out to independent subscribers. However, the evidence never explicitly documents per-participant, per-track selective forwarding, where each subscriber receives only the specific tracks it subscribed to. missing for 10: explicit documentation of track-level subscription filtering per participant, SFU-style conferencing evidence, and independent corroboration of selective per-track delivery.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, media routes through a selective forwarding unit or relay that delivers only the tracks each participant subscribes to
